name: Wellheads and Christmas trees
description: The West Desaru WSS carried 28 dry-tree completions using single, dual and triple splitter wellheads, and ISO 10423:2022 states that it supplements API Spec 6A, 21st edition (2018), for wellhead and tree equipment. Primary source: https://www.drillingformulas.com/surface-christmas-tree-dry-tree-basic-knowlege/
aliases: Wellheads and Christmas trees (dry trees; single/dual/triple splitter configurations)

specifications.metric: Dry-tree (surface) Christmas tree assemb — master valve redundancy
specifications.basis: Typically two master valves (lower and upper) provide redundancy; if one fails the other can perform the function

specifications.metric: Dry-tree (surface) Christmas tree assemb — pressure rating (subsea tree systems)
specifications.basis: Baker Hughes provides 5-inch and 7-inch systems with up-to 15,000 psi pressure rating capability

specifications.metric: Dry-tree (surface) Christmas tree assemb — water depth capability
specifications.basis: Baker Hughes tree systems facilitate control of intelligent completions in water depths up to 10,000 ft

specifications.metric: Dry-tree (surface) Christmas tree assemb — HPHT flowing temperature
specifications.basis: Baker Hughes HPHT Tree system: production pressures up to 15,000 psi, flowing temperatures up to 350 degF

specifications.metric: Dry-tree (surface) Christmas tree assemb — tree configuration count
specifications.basis: West Desaru WSS topsides accommodate 28 dry tree well completions comprising single, dual and triple splitter wellheads

specifications.metric: IC conventional wellhead system (SLB/Cam — pressure rating
specifications.basis: Rated up to 10,000 psi, can be configured for many service conditions

specifications.metric: IC conventional wellhead system (SLB/Cam — load shoulder angle
specifications.basis: IC wellhead system uses a straight-bore design with a 45-degree load shoulder

specifications.metric: Reliability — two master valves used for redundancy
specifications.basis: DrillingFormulas: two master valves provide redundancy so another can perform the function if one fails

specifications.metric: Reliability — fail-safe closed hydraulic wing valve
specifications.basis: Hydraulic operated wing valves usually fail safe closed, requiring active hydraulic pressure to stay open; loss of control fluid shuts the well in
